content.use_of_sequencing: The use of additional sequencing for analysis of very large gene panels may be considered if there is a clear familial history or structural phenotype, preferably combined with family segregation.

specific_conditions.muscular_weakness: Consider mitochondrial X-linked mutations, glycogen storage disorders, FHL1 mutations, Friedreich ataxia.
specific_conditions.syndromic_conditions: Cognitive, visual impairment, drooping eyelid: consider mitochondrial X-linked mutations, Noonan syndrome, Danon disease.

endomyocardial_biopsy.indication: May be considered when baseline clinical assessment suggests cardiac inflammation or storage disease which cannot be diagnosed by other means (see also Section 14.6).
with_LVOTO: Avoid hypovolaemia (dehydration), arterial and venous dilators (nitrates and phosphodiesterase type 5 inhibitors), and digoxin.
Use non-vasodilating beta-blockers or use verapamil if beta-blockers not tolerated or ineffective.
Low-dose loop or thiazide diuretics must be used with caution to improve dyspnoea associated with LVOTO, while avoiding hypovolaemia.

Invasive treatment (septal reduction therapy by alcohol ablation or myomectomy), in experienced centres, may be considered in patients with resting or provoked LVOTO ≥50 mmHg and/or who remain symptomatic (NYHA class III or IV, syncope) despite optimal medical therapy.
Novel drugs or devices may be considered once available.
symptomatic_without_LVOTO: Cautious use of low-dose loop or thiazide diuretics avoiding hypovolaemia.
Verapamil/diltiazem if LVEF >50% and beta-blockers are not tolerated or ineffective.
